unverifiedFromResearch.what: Suggested answers (all levels, all Syllabus 2022 terms)
unverifiedFromResearch.why: The official Suggested Answers page (https://icmai.in/ClntStudents/Suggested_Answers) links only to 'Download Suggested Answers from December 2011 Term upto June 2026 Term' at eicmai.in/Suggested_Answers/registration.aspx, which is a login form titled 'Suggested Answers (Except Foundation Student)' requiring a student Registration No. and an image CAPTCHA. No public direct PDF links exist; per the rules no login/form submission was attempted. The login page itself returns HTTP 200 text/html.

No icmai.in HTML page states paper marks. They appear to be given only in PDFs ('CMA Curriculum 2022 at a Glance', 'CMA Syllabus 2022 Full Version', per-paper curriculum PDFs), which were not downloaded in full per the brief. papers[].marks left null. Needs a human read of Curriculum_2022.pdf.

unverifiedFromResearch.what: Group composition for Intermediate and Final (which papers are in Group I/II/III/IV); whether Foundation has groups
unverifiedFromResearch.why: Groups are confirmed to exist for Intermediate and Final (examicmai.in exam application page: 'Intermediate and Final students, those who have already applied for one group...'), but no HTML page lists which papers belong to which group. levels[].groups left empty and papers[].groupId null. Old group-wise pages (e.g. icmai.in/studentswebsite/Syl-2022-Inter-Stdy-Mtrls_G1.php) seen in search results now return 404.

unverifiedFromResearch.what: Paper format (descriptive / objective / mixed) per paper
unverifiedFromResearch.why: Not stated on any HTML page; only in PDFs not downloaded. papers[].format set to 'unknown'. (An old 2022 circular refers to an 'online Foundation Examination', but that is not evidence of the current format.)

unverifiedFromResearch.what: Foundation question papers for December 2025, June 2025, December 2024, June 2024 and December 2023 terms
unverifiedFromResearch.why: The official question-paper pages for these terms (menuId=2..6) list only Intermediate and Final papers. Foundation papers are listed only for the June 2026 term (menuId=1). Nothing to verify for earlier Foundation terms.

unverifiedFromResearch.what: Model Question Papers (MQP) for other terms / Intermediate / Final
unverifiedFromResearch.why: The MQP page offers December 2023 to December 2026 terms and Foundation/Intermediate/Final, but each selection is a POST form button (with an anti-forgery token), not a link. Per the no-form-submission rule only the default view (December 2026, Foundation, Paper 3) was catalogued.

unverifiedFromResearch.what: Legacy studentswebsite URLs for Syllabus 2022 question papers / MQPs (e.g. exam_qp_D25_2022.php, exam_qp_D24_2022.php, exam_qp_J24.php, mqp2022_fnd.php)
